thread:
maria: Heads up — final checklist for the mini-workshop tomorrow at 11am PT. Want to confirm reg page, Zoom settings, recording capture, and immediate follow-up flow.

sam: Got it. reg page is live: https://go.redwood.ai/miniworkshop — form embed uses HubSpot form ID `hsForm_9823`. Confirmed mobile view.

leo: Zoom meeting created, passcode on. Recording to cloud enabled. Waiting on co-host invites. @tessa can you be co-host?

tessa: Yes I can. Adding co-hosts now. Also turning on "Record active speaker, gallery, and shared screen" so we get both speaker + slides.

maria: Perfect. Important: we want SRT + transcript export. Sam — can your Zap pick up the cloud recording once available and split the clip at slide transitions? Minimal edit, we just need the 60s highlight clip.

sam: Yup. Zapier webhook configured. Zap listens for Zoom recording ready, then posts to our clip service. Mapping snippet: ```json
{
  "zoom_recording_id": "{{id}}",
  "export_format": "srt,mp4",
  "split_on_slide_change": true,
  "tags": ["miniworkshop", "benchmark-demo"]
}
```

anya: For lead routing — all registrants should get a 10-minute follow-up email with replay + 1-click demo CTA. High-intent attendees (attended > 70%) need SDR handoff via HubSpot task. Tag: `event:miniworkshop`, `intent:high`

leo: How are we detecting attendance %? Zoom provides `participant_duration`; Zap will compute percent using `registrant.duration / total_session_length`. I can add that to the payload.

maria: Yes do that. Then HubSpot workflow should: 1) add tag, 2) if intent:high create task for SDR team, 3) otherwise add to nurture sequence. Sam/Tessa — can you confirm HubSpot workflow name and form mapping?

tessa: Workflow name: "MiniWorkshop - Post Event Routing v2". HubSpot form field mapping uses `hsForm_9823` and we map `utm_campaign` -> `source_campaign`.

sam: Confirmed. Also setting up immediate replay email template: Subject: "Thanks for joining — Mini Workshop replay + highlights". Will include clip link and book-demo CTA.

maria: Tagging notes — Marketing needs list of registrants with tags within 15 mins of recording processed. Can we push CSV to S3 + notify #sales via webhook?

sam: Yes. Zap uploads CSV to s3://redwood-marketing/miniworkshop/YYYYMMDD/registrants.csv and posts to #sales with link.

zoom-bot: Recording saved to cloud (ID 9a8f). Transcription ready in ~5m.

anya: Great. Follow-up tasks: 1) Sam monitor Zap until first recording processed, 2) Leo confirm co-hosts 30m before start, 3) Tessa QA replay email, 4) Maria publish short social clip (60s) within 2 hours.

maria: I'll schedule the social clip post once Sam confirms clip is in S3. Thanks all :rocket: 

leo: Co-hosts added. All set from my side.

sam: On watch. Will ping here when the first artifact is uploaded.

maria: Awesome — last note: please ensure we include callout in email to attendees about data retention and recording consent. Use this line: "By joining, you consent to recording for internal use and marketing follow-up."

tessa: Noted. Will add to replay email footer and registration confirmation.

maria: That's it. Team, ping if anything breaks.
